description:
Dinoco Studios is a 2-person team. 

Pratham (Data & AI/Backend): built the satellite pipeline on Microsoft Planetary Computer (Copernicus DEM, Sentinel-1, MODIS, HLS), 8-feature extraction, GPU embeddings, the similarity engine, repo and docs. 

Vivek (Frontend & Pitch): built the Next.js app (3D globe, Moon/Mars explorer, mission modes, site cards, Method page), weighted scoring fix, deployment, demo video, slides and submission.
